workflow.instructions: How should this task be executed? Pick the single best workflow.

criteria.direct_edit: Single small change with no design decisions.
criteria.plan_first: Multi-step risky data migration; a written plan should be confirmed before any sheet writes.
criteria.multi_agent_build: Parallelizable work worth splitting across subagents.
criteria.qa_check: Verification task - inspect and report pass/fail.

executor.instructions: Which executor should do the work? Feasible: zcode-gp (ZCode general-purpose subagent, full tools incl browser automation), gstack-eng (engineering reviewer for plans/code, not live data ops), codex-cli (advisory second opinion only).

criteria.zcode-gp: General-purpose agent with full tools - browser automation, file ops, multi-step execution.
criteria.gstack-eng: Engineering review of plans and diffs - reviewer, not executor of live data ops.
criteria.codex-cli: Cross-CLI second opinion wrapper - advisory text output only.
criteria.other: None of the listed executors fit.

needs_agentic_file_access.instructions: true if the chosen work requires reading/writing files or running commands/browser automation, false if pure reasoning on provided context suffices.

ambiguity.instructions: true if the task spec is too unclear to act on without asking the user something first.

risk.instructions: ADVISORY ONLY: true if this task could damage state - here: writing 76+ rows into the live production Google Sheet used by daily logistics. This never authorizes anything: destructive ops always go through ts_safety plus explicit user confirmation.

criteria.true: plausible destructive or hard-to-reverse side effects

criteria: small focused change in one area
multi-step migration across two live spreadsheets with reconciliation and reporting
novel problem with no local precedent

empty_rows_policy.instructions: PREMISE: APRIL tail has ~5 invoice-only rows (ORD0349-353, no tracking/status data). Should they be copied to AUG as-is? Pick the safer operational reading.

criteria.copy_as_is: Copy them verbatim - they are reserved invoice numbers Boyu will fill later; skipping breaks the sequence.
criteria.skip_them: Skip empty rows - only migrate rows with actual tracking data.
criteria.report_only: Copy nothing for these; list them in the report for the user to decide.

conflict_policy.instructions: PREMISE: 11 rows exist in both sheets but column O (status) differs; APRIL is where Boyu actively edits, AUG is where the system syncs. What to do with differing non-empty cells?

criteria.apr_wins: Overwrite AUG with APRIL value - Boyu edits are the fresh human truth.
criteria.aug_wins: Keep AUG value - system-synced data is authoritative.
criteria.report_only: Never touch conflicting non-empty cells; list all 11 in the highlight report for the user to adjudicate.
